existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: Task has substantial local R4->R6 breaking changes despite stable resource identity. Top concerns are structural remodels of `focus`/`reason`/performer fields, removed formal-definition fields, and the safety-critical R6-only `doNotPerform` modifier. The main uncertainty is official migration intent for `instantiatesUri` and other semantic transforms.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration is mostly not about cardinality minimum increases; it is about representation changes. R4 direct elements often become R6 wrappers (`focus.value[x]`, CodeableReference), several old fields are renamed or merged, reference target domains change, and R6 introduces new semantics for negated tasks and restriction validity. R6-to-R4 conversion needs explicit loss policies for multiple foci/reasons, CodeableReference references, new datatypes, and modifier content.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural, cardinality, flag, and binding changes because both StructureDefinitions and local terminology files were parsed directly. Confidence is medium for justification, prevalence, and detailed terminology effects because official diffs, live expansions, and production instances were not available.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Task keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 7 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 8 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 100/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

4 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Task.instantiatesCanonical and Task.instantiatesUri were removed
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances containing either removed instantiates element have unknown elements in R6; the URI case also creates lossy migration because R6 lacks a native URI slot.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.performerType was replaced by requestedPerformer CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and R6-to-R4 loss: R4 `performerType` elements are unknown in R6, while R6 requestedPerformer.reference values have no R4 performerType representation.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.focus changed from a single Reference to repeating BackboneElement.value[x]
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: old `focus.reference` JSON is structurally invalid in R6, and generated/client APIs must change from a direct Reference to an array of wrapper objects.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.reasonCode and Task.reasonReference were merged into repeating Task.reason CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 reasonCode/reasonReference element names are absent in R6; R6 multiple or reference/concept combinations can also lose structure when downgraded to R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.restriction gained a local invariant requiring fulfill code and Reference focus
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 Task with restriction but without the exact fulfill code or Reference focus becomes invalid under the new R6 error invariant.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.owner targets narrowed and actual performers moved to new Task.performer
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus runtime/API/codegen: Device or HealthcareService owners valid in R4 can fail R6 target validation, and code that treats owner as actual performer must be redesigned around owner versus performer.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.input.value[x] and output.value[x] removed Contributor and added R6-only datatypes
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and R6-to-R4 loss: R4 `valueContributor` is not allowed in R6, while new R6-only datatype choices do not have native R4 representations.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task.statusReason changed from CodeableConcept to repeating CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 CodeableConcept-shaped statusReason is not the R6 CodeableReference wire shape; R6 reference-only and repeated reasons also create R6-to-R4 loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds modifier element Task.doNotPerform to negate the Task
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: R6 modifier content has no native R4 field, and dropping it can reverse task meaning; there is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Task terminology changed: status adds unknown and code binding strengthens to extensible
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: warning-level: R4 status values remain valid, but Task.code extensible binding can create warnings or policy failures for local codes when a standard task-code applies; R6 status unknown is R6-to-R4 loss.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
